context.before: حق الإضراب، 6 منازعات الضمان الاجتماعي والتقاعد، 7 المنازعات المتعلقة

differences.seen: Item 7 on page 41, left column: «7 – المنازعات المتعلقة بـالاتـفـاقـات والاتـفـاقـيـات الجماعية للعمل.» The two words sit side by side on one line. In the first word, the ق is followed straight by alif then ات. There is no extra tooth and no pair of dots below between ق and the alif. The next word, والاتفاقيات, does have that tooth with two dots below (قـيـات), so the difference is visible on the line. The 600 dpi band and the 300 dpi page agree. The article ends on p041, so p042 was not needed.

differences.seen: The first line of p076's right column reads «– الولاية والمصالح غير المـركـزة للدولة على». After the lam-alif article there is a single meem, stretched with a kashida, then ر, then ك, then زة. There is no second meem loop before the ر. The word is about as long as the nearby المصالح, which has one meem. The 600 dpi band and the 300 dpi page agree.
